g-006.translation:
A-Wu, I'm going out
tonight. Don't follow me.

g-005.translation:
Commander Su, why has the Imperial Guard
suddenly changed its watch tonight?

g-002.translation:
Shen Qi's sword only ever
leaves its sheath once.

g-004.translation:
Xiao Jingheng, you oppose me at every
turn. What are you really after?

g-003.translation:
Chancellor Lin, if this gets
out, you may lose your post.

g-007.translation:
Senior Brother, I've reached level seven
of the Flowing Cloud Sword Art you taught me.

g-008.translation:
Your Majesty, the Noble Consort
had this tea brewed for you.

g-001.translation:
Lin Wan'er, would you really
turn on me for a jianghu drifter?

g-009.translation:
Miss, the Wild Goose
Tower is no place for you.

g-011.translation:
The lamps of the Eastern Palace
will likely burn until dawn tonight.

g-010.translation:
I waited for you in Chang'an for three
years, and now you're finally back.

g-014.translation:
Thirty li beyond Baiyu Pass, our
scouts report unusual movement.

g-013.translation:
The threshold of the Lin Residence
isn't for just anyone to tread on.

g-015.translation:
The Tianji Pavilion's
information is never wrong.

g-016.translation:
Someone from the Mirror Bureau slipped
into the Lin Residence last night.

g-012.translation:
Something's stirring at the Western Hills.
The Imperial Guard has already set out.

g-018.translation:
Qingshuang leaves its sheath,
and returns only bloodied.

g-017.translation:
If the tiger tally isn't in the Crown
Prince's hands, then who took it?

g-020.translation:
On the night of the Lantern Festival,
everyone on the city wall must die.

g-022.translation:
In the underworld, no one dares
to refuse a favor to Shen Qi.

g-021.translation:
Miss Lin, does your father
know you're looking into this?

g-019.translation: If the Chang'an Scroll falls to the Second Prince, the realm will fall into chaos.

g-023.translation:
Bai Yu, you didn't hear
any of this. Understand?

g-024.translation:
Jingxing, any word from
the Eastern Palace?

g-025.translation:
Shen Qi, the Tianji Pavilion
has this street under watch.

g-026.translation:
Commander Su, send another
squad to the Western Hills.

g-031.translation: The Second Prince is reaching too far.

g-027.translation:
The Pavilion Master's orders: retrieve
the Chang'an Scroll from Wild Goose Tower.

g-030.translation:
Pawn the white jade hairpin—we
need the silver more.

g-029.translation:
A lifetime of peace means less than
one night walking Chang'an with you.

g-028.translation:
Senior Brother said he taught the Flowing
Cloud Sword Art to me and no one else.

g-034.translation:
I hold the tiger tally.
Who dares to make a move?

g-033.translation:
The Mirror Bureau is on official
business. All bystanders, stand back.

g-032.translation:
The Imperial Guard surrounds the Lin Residence.
Will the Chancellor not come out?

g-036.translation:
What exactly happened at Wild Goose
Tower that night of the Lantern Festival?

g-035.translation:
The urgent report from Baiyu
Pass arrived last night.

g-038.translation:
Miss Lin, Master Xiao awaits
you in the Eastern Palace.

g-037.translation:
The autumn hunt nears. The Second
Prince begs to join the escort.

g-039.translation:
Is Shen Qi's Flowing Cloud
Sword Art truly unbreakable?

g-040.translation:
Heaven's secrets must not be
revealed. You should know that.

g-042.translation:
Su Feng, this squad of the Imperial
Guard answers only to your command.

g-043.translation:
"Peace year after year"—what pretty words.
Too bad she can't hear them anymore.

g-041.translation:
Your Majesty, Uncle Chen begs an audience.
Something has happened at the Lin Residence.

g-044.translation:
As long as the Chang'an Scroll stays
hidden, Chang'an will never know peace.

g-045.translation:
If you're looking for information, Miss,
Wild Goose Tower is the best place.

g-047.translation:
Senior Brother, Master wants
you at the Tianji Pavilion.

g-048.translation: Senior Brother, three years of the Flowing Cloud Sword Art, and I still can't grasp it.

g-051.translation:
Senior Brother, the Second Prince's
men have already entered Chang'an.

g-046.translation:
Shen Qi, the Pavilion Master wants you.
He says there's a mole in the Tianji Pavilion.

g-049.translation: Senior Brother, a sedan's here. It's headed for the Eastern Palace.

g-050.translation:
Senior Brother, you take the Crown
Prince and go first. Leave this to me.

g-053.translation:
Senior Brother, those wounds on you—did
the Imperial Guard give you those?

g-054.translation:
Your Highness, Baiyu Pass lies
just ahead. Please change horses.

g-052.translation:
Senior Brother, the Pavilion Master said
the Chang'an Scroll mustn't fall to others.

g-058.translation:
Your Highness, it would be safer for
you to keep the tiger tally yourself.

g-055.translation:
Your Highness, I've gotten to the
bottom of that Lantern Festival night.

g-056.translation:
Your Highness, Commander Su is here.
He says he has something urgent to report.

g-057.translation:
Your Highness, if you go to the Western Hills,
no one will guard the Eastern Palace.

g-059.translation: Your Highness, the Second Prince has waited at the gate for half an hour.

g-062.translation:
Your Majesty, the Second Prince awaits
outside the hall to pay his respects.

g-060.translation:
Your Highness, Uncle Chen says things
are uneasy at the Lin Residence today.

g-061.translation:
Your Majesty, is the Noble
Consort feeling any better today?

g-066.translation:
Your Majesty, the roster for the autumn
hunt is ready. Please have a look.

g-063.translation:
Your Majesty, the Mirror Bureau entered
the palace last night. Did you know?

g-067.translation:
Your Majesty, I fear the Tianji Pavilion
already knows what we're planning.

g-064.translation:
Calm down, Your Majesty. Bai Yu is
just a songstress—she can't make waves.

g-065.translation:
Your Majesty, Chancellor
Lin has sent in a memorial.

g-069.translation:
Miss, Uncle Chen says the carriage
is ready at the back gate.

g-068.translation:
Miss, I've wiped your
Qingshuang sword clean for you.

g-071.translation:
Miss, the Chancellor asks you to
come to the front hall tomorrow.

g-075.translation:
Miss, the Mirror Bureau has traced things
to the Lin Residence. What are we to do?

g-072.translation:
Miss, a man outside says he's
Shen Qi, sent to protect you.

g-074.translation:
Miss, the Lantern Festival crowd
is thick—please stay close to me.

g-070.translation:
Miss, word from Wild Goose Tower—
Lord Xiao will be going there tonight.

g-073.translation:
Miss, word from Baiyu Pass. The
master's raging in his study.

g-076.translation:
Miss, if word of this reaches
Consort Liu, we're in trouble.

g-078.translation:
Commander Su, movement in the Western Hills.
The Imperial Guard must watch all night.

g-077.translation:
Wan'er, the Crown Prince comes to the Lin
Residence tonight. Go change your clothes.

g-082.translation:
A-Wu, fetch the Qingshuang Sword.
I'm going to Wild Goose Tower.

g-079.translation:
Consort Liu orders: the Second Prince
may not enter the Eastern Palace tonight.

g-083.translation:
On Lantern Festival night, Baiyu Pass's
urgent report reached the Mirror Bureau.

g-081.translation:
Jingxing, who taught you
the Flowing Cloud Sword Art?

g-084.translation:
Senior Brother, who exactly is the
Pavilion Master of the Tianji Pavilion?

g-080.translation: The Pavilion Master says we won't take the Chang'an Scroll case.

g-086.translation:
Miss, Wild Goose Tower is just ahead.
Bai Yu is waiting for you upstairs.

g-085.translation: Your Highness, the tiger tally is gone from the Eastern Palace. The Second Prince likely has it now.

g-088.translation:
Shen Qi, that man in black with the
Second Prince—did you find out who he is?

g-089.translation:
Brother Su, the Mirror Bureau's
men have already entered Chang'an.

g-091.translation:
Wan'er, was this white jade hairpin
a gift from the Crown Prince?

g-087.translation:
The autumn hunt nears. The Imperial Guard
rides with the Crown Prince to the Western Hills.

g-090.translation:
Chancellor Lin, if the Scroll is in
the Lin Residence, you're implicated.

g-092.translation: Don't worry, Senior Brother. I only used 30% of the Flowing Cloud Sword Art.

g-093.translation:
Uncle Chen, ready the carriage.
I'm going to the Tianji Pavilion.

g-095.translation:
Bai Yu, the honored guest at Wild Goose
Tower tonight is from the Lin Residence.

g-096.translation:
A-Wu, your young lady's Qingshuang
Sword is faster than my blade.

g-094.translation: Calm down, Your Majesty. The Second Prince just went hunting in the Western Hills.

g-097.translation:
Commander Su, whoever holds the tiger
tally commands the Imperial Guard.

g-098.translation:
Jingheng, has your mother, Consort Liu,
ever mentioned the Chang'an Scroll?

g-101.translation:
Uncle Chen, no one is to enter
the Lin Residence tonight.

g-099.translation:
Your Highness, the Mirror Bureau
has watched the Eastern Palace all night.

g-100.translation:
Miss Lin, on Lantern Festival night,
did you see anyone from Baiyu Pass?

g-105.translation:
Heaven's secrets must not
be revealed. Ask no more.

g-107.translation:
The ground is white with frost,
and it's not even dawn yet.

g-102.translation: Senior Brother, the Pavilion Master says heaven's secrets mustn't be told—but I'll look into it anyway.

g-103.translation:
Wait, Miss. Bai Yu says Wild Goose
Tower doesn't serve the Imperial Guard.

g-106.translation:
This white jade hairpin
is what my mother left me.

g-104.translation:
In this life, may you have
peace—I will stay by your side.

g-108.translation:
Peace year after year—that is
the people's greatest wish.

g-109.translation:
Look at this white jade bracelet.
The quality's quite good, actually.

g-111.translation:
Morning frost settles on
the tiles, cold and biting.

g-110.translation:
The ways of heaven are profound and
mysterious—how could a mortal fathom them?

g-114.translation:
The Pavilion Master said
fate cannot be forced.

g-113.translation:
That white jade pendant—did you
bring it from beyond the pass?

g-116.translation:
This concerns the will of
Heaven. It cannot be spoken of.

g-112.translation:
May the Great Ming's realm
know peace for all time.

g-115.translation:
The floor is paved with white jade—I'm
afraid to dirty it just by stepping on it.

g-117.translation: Such heavy rain in Chang'an is rare.

g-118.translation:
The white jade hairpin in
her hand fell and shattered.

g-119.translation:
The frost hasn't melted yet.
Mind your step on the road.

g-123.translation:
Thirty li outside Chang'an,
there stands a ruined temple.

g-125.translation:
Frost has formed on the window,
like a thin layer of snow.

g-121.translation:
That white jade screen was
a gift from the palace.

g-120.translation:
All I ask is peace year
after year. Nothing more.

g-122.translation:
Heaven's will is hard to fathom. No
one can say what tomorrow brings.

g-124.translation:
A white jade piece clicks
softly onto the board.

g-126.translation: Revealing heaven's secrets shortens your life.

g-128.translation:
The moonlight in Chang'an is
brighter than anywhere else.

g-127.translation:
That white jade flute of yours—it
melts the heart to hear it.

g-133.translation: This white jade cup holds poisoned wine.

g-132.translation:
May your journey ahead
be peaceful all the way.

g-134.translation:
Heaven's will has its own
course. Why struggle against it?

g-129.translation:
The wheels of fate are turning.
We're all caught in the game.

g-130.translation:
Before the white jade steps, he
knelt the whole night through.

g-139.translation:
Don't just stand at the
door. Come in and sit down.

g-135.translation:
Halls of white jade, horses
of gold—nothing but a dream.

g-136.translation:
Drink this bowl of porridge first.
It won't taste good once it's cold.

g-137.translation:
It rained so hard last night, and
I didn't even shut my window tight.

g-142.translation:
You can say that to me,
but don't let it spread.

g-140.translation: You look a bit pale. Did you sleep badly?

g-138.translation: Is that a new dress? The color suits you.

g-144.translation:
You rest for now. I'll
take care of the rest.

g-143.translation: I've packed everything. We leave at dawn.

g-141.translation:
There's still warm soup on
the stove. Want a bowl too?

g-147.translation: When you smile, your eyes curve.

g-148.translation: Don't rush off. I'm not finished talking.

g-146.translation:
When I was little, thunder
scared me most. Not anymore.

g-149.translation:
This brew is very bitter. I've
prepared some candied fruit for you.

g-145.translation:
The tree in the courtyard is blooming
exceptionally well this year.

g-150.translation:
Your old cloak was torn,
so I mended it for you.

g-151.translation:
So many people on the street today—I
got shoved so hard I lost my shoe.

g-157.translation: If you're tired, lean on me and sleep for a while.

g-155.translation: I'm hungry. Do you have any food left?

g-154.translation:
Why is it so cold in
here? Where's the brazier?

g-152.translation:
My mother always said, leave
some room in everything you do.

g-153.translation:
Stop worrying about me all the
time. I know what I'm doing.

g-164.translation: You go on ahead. I'll be right there.

g-156.translation:
I hear the family next door just had
a baby boy. Quite the celebration.

g-159.translation:
That came out harsher than I
meant. Don't take it to heart.

g-162.translation:
It's cold out. Remember to put
on an extra layer before you go.

g-158.translation:
I'll come get you first thing
tomorrow morning. Don't oversleep.

g-161.translation:
Don't look at me. There's
nothing written on my face.

g-167.translation: I've saved up some money. I want to buy you a new pair.

g-160.translation:
I've been searching for half a day, only
to find it was in my hands all along.

g-163.translation:
I'm not good with words.
I can't say pretty things.

g-165.translation:
It's not your fault. I just
didn't think it through.

g-166.translation: Look at the moon—it's as round as a plate.

g-172.translation:
Your Highness, the Mirror Bureau has
caught wind of that shipment you wanted.

g-171.translation:
Commander Su, not a single soldier from
the Western Hills camp is to move tonight.

g-173.translation:
Miss, this white jade hairpin is of the
finest quality. Would you like to try it?

g-168.translation:
Your Highness, the Imperial Guard
have waited at Xuanwu Gate two hours.

g-169.translation:
Seventh Brother, word from the Tianji Pavilion:
the Pavilion Master wants to see you tonight.

g-170.translation:
Bai Yu, the song that gentleman
downstairs requested—do you know it?

g-174.translation:
Jingxing, are you really going to hand
the tiger tally to Chancellor Lin?

g-181.translation: Wan'er, whose blood is this on Qingshuang?

g-179.translation:
Your Highness, the Mirror Bureau's
men have already entered Chang'an.

g-176.translation:
Seventh Brother, that's the Flowing Cloud
Sword Art—not a common fighter's style.

g-175.translation: Your Majesty, the Second Prince is not home tonight. We lost his trail.

g-177.translation:
Miss Lin, someone left a note at our
gate. It just says "the Lantern Festival."

g-178.translation:
Bai Yu, listen carefully—that
customer said Baiyu Pass.

g-180.translation:
Qi, the matter the Pavilion Master had you
look into—is it about the Chang'an Scroll?

g-182.translation:
Second Prince, the Crown Prince has the
tally. Why haven't you made your move?

g-187.translation:
Jingheng, your brother is waiting for you
at the Eastern Palace. You must go today.

g-184.translation:
Senior Brother, heaven's secrets
must not be told. Do you buy that?

g-188.translation:
Wan'er, wear this white jade hairpin.
Don't let anyone recognize you.

g-183.translation:
Brother Su, has the Imperial Guard's
shift change tonight been moved?

g-185.translation:
Miss, word from Wild Goose
Tower: a guest of honor tonight.

g-186.translation:
Your Highness, the Second Prince's name
is on the list for the autumn hunt.

g-189.translation:
Brother Qi, before he died, he only
said two words: the Western Hills.

g-191.translation:
Senior Brother, if the Pavilion
Master is that man, what do we do?

g-190.translation:
Your Highness, I venture to
ask—do you trust Miss Lin?

g-192.translation: Your Majesty, the Imperial Guard has surrounded the Lin Residence, on the Crown Prince's orders.
